_readme: Every recorded forecast for a council by-election, one entry per contest per forecaster. Scored by scripts/lib/byelection-scoreboard.mjs and shown at /by-elections/scoreboard/. How to add an outside forecaster's call: data/scoreboard/README.md.

rules.live: An entry is live only if captured_at is before polls opened for that contest, 07:00 UK time on polling day. A bare date counts as the last moment of that day, so it proves a live capture only when it falls before polling day.
rules.retrospective: Every other entry, however it was made. Live and retrospective entries are never added together.
rules.lanes: Parties are pooled into six lanes: Reform UK, Labour, Conservative, Liberal Democrats, Green Party and Others. Others pools independents and every smaller party.
rules.leader: The leader of a result is the lane with the highest share of the vote after pooling. A forecaster's called leader is the party it named as most likely to win, pooled the same way.

uk-elections.name: UK Elections
uk-elections.description: This site's published council by-election projection: the ward's previous result moved by the swing measured at recent by-elections.

uk-elections-research-model.name: UK Elections research ward model
uk-elections-research-model.description: An all-party ward model trained only on results before 7 May 2026 and run in November 2026 on the council by-elections held since. It was not published before any of these polls, so every entry is a back-test.
uk-elections-research-model.export_note: Copied unchanged, meta block included, from research/ward-model-2026-11/cache/scoreboard_export.json on branch claude/research-ward-model-all-party-b40f30 (ukelections PR 185), where it is an untracked cache file. Exported 27 November 2026.
